definitions.listed_unique_records: Deduplicated entities retained from ingested public sources, including unvalidated entries.
definitions.validated_reachable_records: Metadata passed adapter checks and its declared endpoint/Agent Card was reachable on last check; this does not prove safe behavior or full protocol functionality.
definitions.independently_verified_operators: Distinct operator identities explicitly marked independently_verified with recorded evidence; source self-claims and endpoint reachability do not count.

caveat: This is a source-bounded census, not a claim to enumerate every AI agent on the internet.
